column1: # A note ending in `!extended` marks a deck too expensive for a routine run.
# This whole corpus is nightly-tier, and that is a property of the corpus
# rather than a concession. The *smallest* circuit, c432, is 160 gates over a
# 45nm BSIM4 card and takes ~10 s for its 1 ns transient; c7552_ann is 3512
# gates with extracted parasitics on every net across ~89k netlist lines.
# There is no subset of this corpus that belongs in a per-commit gate, so
# rather than pretend otherwise the routine run covers discovery and manifest
# integrity only, and `RSPICE_EXECUTION_EXTENDED=1` runs the simulations.
# Raise `RSPICE_EXECUTION_DECK_TIMEOUT_MS` alongside it: the 120 s default is
# sized for the paranoia corpus, and the annotated circuits here need more.
# Every deck is required to execute. That is the requirement rather than an
# observation: at the time of vendoring only c432_ann_oc had been run to
# completion inside a bounded budget, and the rest are unmeasured. A nightly
# run is what settles them, and any that turn out to refuse or hit a gap get
# their row corrected here with the specific reason — which is the suite
# The `_ann` variants carry extracted parasitic capacitance on every net; the
# `_oc` variants open-circuit the outputs. Gate counts are the published
# c7552p differs from c7552 in .OPTIONS (tighter GMIN/ABSTOL, noopiter) and
# adds .param drive levels. Not a duplicate; the other `p` directories were
# byte-identical and were dropped at vendoring.
